changeSet.comment: Labelled identifiers per organization, one of them the reporting code
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX organization_identifier_value_idx ON clinlims.organization_identifier (lower(label), lower(value));

changeSet.author: mozzy11
changeSet.comment: Each stored code becomes the identifier "Code" (the reporting code) and each CLIA number the identifier "CLIA"
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.organization_identifier (id, organization_id, label, value, is_reporting, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.organization_identifier_seq'), o.id, 'Code', trim(o.code), true, now() FROM clinlims.organization o WHERE o.code IS NOT NULL AND trim(o.code) <> '';

INSERT INTO clinlims.organization_identifier (id, organization_id, label, value, is_reporting, lastupdated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.organization_identifier_seq'), o.id, 'CLIA', trim(o.clia_num), false, now() FROM clinlims.organization o WHERE o.clia_num IS NOT NULL AND trim(o.clia_num) <> '';

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM clinlims.dictionary_category WHERE name = 'Facility category'

changeSet.comment: Admin-managed facility categories offered on organizations

column.name: description
column.value: Kinds of facility an organization can be

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.dictionary (id, is_active, dict_entry, lastupdated, local_abbrev, dictionary_category_id, sort_order) SELECT nextval('clinlims.dictionary_seq'), 'Y', v.entry, now(), v.abbrev, (SELECT id FROM clinlims.dictionary_category WHERE name = 'Facility category'), v.sort_order FROM (VALUES ('National referral hospital', 'FC-NATREF', 1), ('Provincial hospital', 'FC-PROV', 2), ('District hospital', 'FC-DIST', 3), ('Health centre', 'FC-HC', 4), ('Urban clinic', 'FC-URBAN', 5), ('Aid post', 'FC-AIDPOST', 6), ('Laboratory', 'FC-LAB', 7)) AS v(entry, abbrev, sort_order);
